mission: DevSoc exists to turn curious beginners into confident builders. We run hands-on workshops, ship real projects, and connect members with mentors, internships, and each other.
vision: A campus where every student who wants to build software has the community, mentorship, and stage to do it.
story: DevSoc started as a handful of students meeting in a hostel room to prep for hackathons. A few semesters later we run weekly build sessions, a mentorship track, a certificate program, and an annual demo day for member projects.

values.title: Build in public
values.description: We ship real projects, not just slide decks, and we show our work at every stage.

values.title: Teach what you learn
values.description: Members who learn a skill run a session on it. Knowledge compounds when it's shared.

values.title: Credibility over hype
values.description: Every certificate we issue is verifiable. Every claim on this site should be checkable.

values.title: Everyone starts somewhere
values.description: No prior experience is required to join. We meet people where they are.

howWeOperate: Sub-teams (Tech, Design, Content, Management) run day-to-day with a coordinator each.
Core team meets weekly to plan events, review budgets, and approve new initiatives.
Any member can propose a workshop, project, or blog post through the site.
Certificates are issued only for verified participation and logged in the public registry.
